description: Intent i015 (SNAPSHOT=s14, BRANCH=xmit-softirq-lock) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1981-2040, quote "spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock);". priv->stream_lock is acquired with plain spin_lock() (never spin_lock_bh/irqsave anywhere in the file) in mwl8k_txq_xmit (mwl8k.c:1888-2122, lock sites 1982/2046/2069), which is reached from ieee80211_ops .tx = mwl8k_tx (mwl8k.c:4676, dispatching at 4690) — mac80211 invokes .tx from TX softirq context, and the same function deliberately takes priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh (2054/2115), proving the path runs with BH enabled. The same stream_lock is taken plainly from process/workqueue context: mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events worker (3822, queued from hardirq at 4605 via ieee80211_queue_work), mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (4152, sta removal), and mwl8k_ampdu_action (5445). A NET_TX softirq on the same CPU spinning on stream_lock against a preempted worker holder that can never resume = soft-lockup/RCU-stall/TX-stall DoS, the exact seed mechanism (missing spin_lock_bh on a process-vs-softirq shared lock). Triggers are ordinary traffic plus BA-watchdog/station-removal events. NEGATIVE/OTHER: seed ks7010 present in s14 at the pre-patch state (ks7010_sdio.c:398 plain spin_lock) but excluded as the demonstration; wilc1000 txq_spinlock uses irqsave at every site (safe); rsi has no plain spin_lock acquisitions (safe); qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock (30/47/87/136) left unresolved; iwlwifi pcie/rx.c and hostap plain-spin_lock hotspots not analyzed before halt. Bounded negative evidence: full driver-level softirq reachability was completed only for mwl8k, qtnfmac, wilc1000, rsi within drivers/net/wireless, drivers/staging wireless trees, and drivers/net/usb. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i015.json (snapshots_checked=["s14"], 1 finding, 4 candidates, limitations recorded).
